duration.text: The Mechanical engineering at Wuhan University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: certificate of non-criminal recordEnglish profiviency test certificateBank statement of the applicant or financial sponsorDescription of school performance（for applicants who have learning expericence in China）Valid physical examination reportFront pages of passport and visa page issued by Chinese embassies（if there are any）Passport photoSenior high school Certifacate/diploma or A Level CertificateSenior high school academic transcript or A level transcripts

requirements.text: Applicants should be healthy and well-behaved, and have a foreign citizenship.Applicants should have good academic records and an educational background equivalent to that of the Chinese high school diploma.Applicants should be between the ages of 18 and 25. Language RequirementsEnglish language proficiency certificate is required for programs taught in English and applicants who are not nativeEnglish speakers, which include score report of English Proficiency test likeTOEFL 80+/ IELTS 6.0+/ TOEFL My Best/ TOEFL iBT Home Edition/ TOEFL Essentials, and etc. For applicants who cannot offer the above-mentioned standardized English test results, they will be required to participate in an additional oral or written English test organized by Wuhan University of Technology.
